extracted_data.name: M14-359 Imaging & Central Reading
extracted_data.description: Tumor assessment and imaging specifications for Protocol M14-359.

provenance.text_snippet: A Randomized, Open-Label, Multicenter, Phase 3 Trial Comparing Veliparib Plus Carboplatin and Paclitaxel Versus Investigator's Choice of Standard Chemotherapy in Subjects Receiving First Cytotoxic Chemotherapy for Metastatic or Advanced Non-Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and Who Are Current or Former Smokers

Appendix H. RECIST (Version 1.1) for Tumor Response (PFS)
Response criteria will be assessed using RECIST (version 1.1). Changes in the measurable lesions over the course of therapy must be evaluated using the criteria listed below.

imaging_modalities.technical_requirements: Conventional CT should be performed with cuts of 5 mm or less in slice thickness contiguously. A scale should be incorporated into all radiographic measurements. Non-contrast CT may be performed if IV contrast is contraindicated due to allergy or renal insufficiency.

provenance.text_snippet: A CT scan of the full chest and abdomen (with image of liver and adrenal glands) will be used in the evaluation of tumor responses, as per Table 2... If the subject is unable to undergo a CT scan with IV contrast due to allergy or renal insufficiency, a non-contrast CT may be performed.

imaging_modalities.technical_requirements: MRI can be performed if required by local law, but should have sponsor approval. It is an alternative to CT for brain imaging if CT is contraindicated.

provenance.text_snippet: A baseline MRI (or CT if MRI is contraindicated) of the brain is to be performed on any subject with signs or symptoms suggesting CNS involvement by tumor.

assessment_schedule.on_treatment_frequency: On Cycle 3 Day 1 and Cycle 5 Day 1.
assessment_schedule.post_treatment_schedule: Every 9 weeks (± 7 days) until 1 year after beginning treatment, then every 12 weeks (± 7 days) until radiographic progression or death.
assessment_timepoints: Post-treatment: q9 weeks for 1 year, then q12 weeks

provenance.text_snippet: Tumor assessments will be performed at baseline prior to treatment on Cycle 3 Day 1 and Cycle 5 Day 1. After cessation of platinum doublet therapy, tumor assessments will be performed q9 weeks until 1 year after beginning treatment (C1D-2) (or beyond 1 year until maintenance therapy is discontinued), then q12 weeks until radiographic progression or death.

lesion_requirements.measurable_disease_definition: Presence of at least one measurable lesion. Measurable lesions are accurately measured in at least one dimension with a minimum size of ≥ 10 mm longest diameter (for non-nodal lesions) or ≥ 15 mm short axis (for lymph nodes).
lesion_requirements.non_target_lesion_definition: All other lesions (or sites of disease) including pathological lymph nodes with short axis ≥ 10 mm but < 15 mm, and truly non-measurable lesions.
non_measurable_disease: lymphangitic involvement of skin or lung
abdominal masses not confirmed by imaging

provenance.text_snippet: Measurable Lesions Lesions accurately measured in at least one dimension with a minimum size of: Longest diameter ≥ 10 mm... Measurable Malignant Lymph Nodes To be considered pathologically enlarged and measurable, a lymph node must be ≥ 15 mm in short axis... Non-Measurable Lesions All other lesions, including small lesions (longest diameter < 10 mm) as well as truly non-measurable lesions.

response_categories.definition: Disappearance of all target lesions. Any pathological lymph nodes (whether target or non-target) must have reduction in short axis to < 10 mm.
response_categories.non_target_lesion_criteria: Disappearance of all non-target lesions and normalization of tumor marker level.

provenance.text_snippet: Complete Response (CR): The disappearance of all target lesions. Any pathological lymph nodes (whether target or non-target) must have reduction in short axis to < 10 mm.

response_categories.definition: At least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions, taking as reference the baseline sum diameters.
response_categories.target_lesion_criteria: ≥30% decrease in sum of longest diameters of target lesions.
response_categories.non_target_lesion_criteria: Persistence of one or more non-target lesion(s) and/or maintenance of tumor marker level above the normal limits.

provenance.text_snippet: Partial Response (PR): At least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions, taking as reference the baseline sum diameters.

response_categories.definition: At least a 20% increase in the sum of the LD of target lesions, taking as reference the smallest sum LD recorded since the treatment started (baseline or after) or the appearance of one or more new lesions. In addition to the relative increase of 20%, the sum must also demonstrate an absolute increase of at least 5 mm.
response_categories.target_lesion_criteria: ≥20% increase in sum of longest diameters of target lesions (with absolute increase of ≥5mm) over nadir.
response_categories.non_target_lesion_criteria: Unequivocal progression of existing non-target lesions.
response_categories.new_lesion_criteria: Appearance of one or more new lesions.

provenance.text_snippet: Progressive Disease (PD): At least a 20% increase in the sum of the LD of target lesions, taking as reference the smallest sum LD recorded since the treatment started (baseline or after) or the appearance of one or more new lesions. In addition to the relative increase of 20%, the sum must also demonstrate an absolute increase of at least 5 mm.

response_categories.definition: Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD, taking as reference the smallest sum LD since the treatment started (baseline or after).
response_categories.target_lesion_criteria: Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD.
response_categories.non_target_lesion_criteria: Persistence of one or more non-target lesion(s) and/or maintenance of tumor marker level above the normal limits.

provenance.text_snippet: Stable Disease (SD): Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD, taking as reference the smallest sum LD since the treatment started (baseline or after).

Radiographic information will be collected to determine response according to the Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1. Toxicities will be graded at each study visit according to the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 4.0.

The Investigator will document subject data in his/her own subject files. These subject files will serve as source data for the study. All eCRF data required by this protocol will be recorded by investigative site personnel in the EDC system. All data entered into the eCRF will be supported by source documentation.

special_assessments.purpose: To confirm absence of CNS metastases in subjects with signs or symptoms of CNS involvement.
special_assessments.methodology: Standard clinical MRI or CT scan.

provenance.text_snippet: A baseline MRI (or CT if MRI is contraindicated) of the brain is to be performed on any subject with signs or symptoms suggesting CNS involvement by tumor.
